messages:
alex: Heads-up — I pushed a quick prototype for the scrubber + sampling interaction to figma: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz. Wanted to surface a couple of edge cases I ran into.
maria: nice. can you summarize the behavior? quick bullets?
alex: sure — main problem: when sampling is enabled (10% sampling), the scrubber's hover preview shows p95 computed on the sampled set, which jumps around and is misleading. users expect the scrubber to show an estimate or indicate sampling, not raw sampled p95.
jamal: yeah that surprised me during QA. saw p95 swing 300ms -> 1.2s as I dragged.
leo: could we show a badge: "estimated (sampling on)" next to the metric? also gray outline on the value so it's visually different.
olivia: Accessibility nit: if we add a badge, make sure the screen reader reads "p95 estimate, sampling enabled" and not just "p95". Also ensure keyboard focus lands on the scrubber handle and exposes the current value.
alex: agree. Proposed options in figma: 1) show sampled value + small tooltip "based on 10% sample — ±X ms" 2) show rescaled/confidence interval: p95 ± delta 3) switch scrubber preview to show full-data aggregates from a cached backend call (if available).
maria: option 3 sounds best for accuracy but has perf implications. how often would we fetch? every drag event? :grimacing:
jamal: don't call on every pixel move. throttle to 200ms and debounce final value on mouseup. fallback to option 1 if backend call fails.
leo: copy suggestion for tooltip: "Estimated from sampled requests (10%). True p95 may vary. Refresh to recalc." Shorter alt: "Estimate — 10% sampling." Thoughts?
olivia: pls use the word "estimate" not "approximate" for screen reader clarity. Also include aria-live region updates while dragging so assistive tech hears changes.
alex: another edge: when sampling toggles mid-range (user flips sampling toggle while scrubber open), the scrubber handle jumps because data source changed. We should animate a crossfade and show a transient callout: "Data source changed — showing estimated values".
maria: +1 to crossfade. Can we also persist the last full-data value as faded baseline behind the scrubbed line so users compare?
jamal: that might clutter the chart at small heights. Maybe show baseline only on hover or when user holds alt/option.
leo: implementation detail: CSS-wise, use reduced-motion prefs to skip crossfade animation for users who disable motion.
olivia: accessibility QA checklist I'll add: keyboard drag increments (left/right arrow) respect step granularity, scrubber announces sampling state, aria-live polite for updates, motion respect.
alex: design decision: do we change the tooltip copy when sampling < 5% to warn "low sample — low confidence"? we had a support ticket where customers misread tiny samples as reliable.
maria: yes. heuristics: if sample_rate < 5% show red/orange microbadge and text "low sample — use caution". if between 5-20% show yellow "estimate". >20% show neutral "estimate".
jamal: logging/analytics: record when users see the warning badge so PM can gauge confusion. Add event: ui.scrubber.sample_warning_shown.
leo: UI microcopy proposal: for 3 states use single words for compactness: "Low sample", "Estimate", "Sampled" and full tooltip elaboration on hover.
olivia: for voiceover: make sure the longer phrase reads, not the single-word badge. badge is visual only; sr-only text contains the full sentence.
alex: one more: keyboard-only flow — when user tabs to scrubber, hitting space enters drag mode; escape cancels and reverts to previous timestamp. Also we need visible focus ring on the handle (contrast >= 3:1 with background).
maria: can we add a quick mock of keyboard focus in figma? I'll update frames.
jamal: dev note: server can return both sampled_aggregate and extrapolated_estimate if we ask with ?include_extrapolated=true — cheaper than full scan but better than raw sample. use that for the 200ms throttle path.
leo: designbot: remind us to run accessibility pass after copy changes :designbot:
designbot: Reminder queued — accessibility pass scheduled for next design sprint review. :white_check_mark:
olivia: ok I'll draft the a11y checklist and sample copy variations and post here.
alex: thanks all — next steps: maria to update figma with badge states + keyboard mock; jamal to prototype throttled backend call; olivia to post a11y checklist; leo to write motion/contrast specs. We'll reconvene after mocks. :thumbsup:
maria: updating now, expected by EOD.
jamal: I'll spike the backend call tomorrow.
leo: adding reduced-motion guidance to the spec doc.
olivia: drafting checklist now, will ping when done.
alex: closing loop — linking updated figma once changes are in: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz — will update thread_ts if I repush prototype.
